Tap to boost the call volume
Android only lets LocalBuds change the call volume while LocalBuds is open. Tap to open it and boost this call.
Android blocked the call volume boost because LocalBuds wasn\'t open. Open LocalBuds, or tap its notification, during the call to boost it.
